channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Autos in Indian markets. Today: headwind (−1.4).

item.title: [−1] RBI rate panel in day two; decision due October 7 with a 25 bps hike to 5.50% widely expected
item.description:
The MPC concludes tomorrow. Most economists expect the first hike since February 2023, from 5.25%. The 10-year G-Sec yield stood at 7.21% on October 5. Ongoing: expectations unchanged since last week.

Autos: mild headwind (−1) — Vehicle loans set to get dearer

Why it matters: A hike is largely priced; the statement on further tightening and the inflation forecast will move bond yields, the rupee and rate-sensitive sectors such as housing and autos.

Market gauges: Bond market (G-Secs) −2, Growth outlook −1, Rupee +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] India–US trade talks have 'reached a plateau', finance minister says; compromise 'very difficult'
item.description:
Sitharaman said further give-and-take would be very difficult, after a US law allowed tariffs of up to 100% on big buyers of Russian oil. Talks continue. Escalating from last week's reports of delays.

Autos: mild headwind (−1) — Auto-parts exports exposed

Why it matters: A stalled deal keeps US tariff risk hanging over Indian exporters and weighs on foreign investor sentiment and the rupee.

Market gauges: Growth outlook −1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1, Rupee −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months
